newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Yanjing brewery limits foreign investment.
newsitem.headline: China's Yanjing brewery limits foreign investment.

text.p: China's largest beer producer, Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co, has refused to enter into a joint venture in which foreign investors have a controlling interest, a company official said on Tuesday.
The company wants to cooperate only with foreign partners that agree to take less than a 30 percent of stake in any joint venture, a Yanjing official said.
"Yanjing is an important national brand, we must protect our brand," the official said by telephone.
Yanjing has 85 percent of the Beijing market and a 25 percent market share in the nearby port city of Tianjin, he said.
The brewer's pre-tax profits were 357.99 milion yuan ($43.13 million) in 1996, up 58.2 percent from 1995, while total output of beer was 571,000 tonnes, up 68.2 percent from 1995, state media said.
